en.headline: Citywide Halloween cosplay events continue across five districts this weekend
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s first Halloween Month features street parties in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East on Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board is staging its first citywide Halloween Month, with cosplay street parties scheduled across five districts on Saturdays including 24 October.

According to the board, events run in Central at Statue Square Gardens and Chater Road, at Kai Tak Sports Park’s Dining Cove, in Lan Kwai Fong, outside Langham Place in Mong Kok, and at Mody Road Garden in Tsim Sha Tsui East.

Activities include DJ performances, costume parades, family programmes and installations. Costumed visitors can also ride free on certain themed trams and open-top buses on the event Saturdays through 31 October.

zh.headline: 全城萬聖節Cosplay活動本周末五區繼續舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局首個萬聖節月於中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖東舉行街頭派對，本周六有活動。
body: 香港旅遊發展局正舉辦首個全城萬聖節月，包括本周六在內的星期六在五個地區舉行Cosplay街頭派對。
旅發局表示，活動地點包括中環皇后像廣場花園及遮打道、啟德體育園美食海灣、蘭桂坊、旺角朗豪坊外及尖沙咀東麼地道花園。
節目包括DJ表演、變裝巡遊、親子活動及裝置。穿上造型的市民在活動星期六至10月31日可免費乘搭部分主題電車及開蓬巴士。
